title: Managing Stress and Burnout
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind managing stress and burnout and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply managing stress and burnout in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using managing stress and burnout to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

modules.title: Understanding the Topic
modules.description: Learn what managing stress and burnout means and why it matters for child development.

modules.title: Core Skills and Strategies
modules.description: Explore practical skills and strategies for applying managing stress and burnout in everyday parenting.

modules.title: Real-Life Application
modules.description: See how managing stress and burnout works in real situations with examples and simple scripts.

modules.title: Reflection and Integration
modules.description: Reflect on your learning and plan how to use managing stress and burnout in daily family life.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to managing stress and burnout. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
